title: PayPal Holdings, Inc. Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: The filing supports the PYPL/XNAS/USD identity, Q2 financial position and risks, including PYUSD distribution through PayPal and Venmo under evolving stablecoin rules.
summary: The unchanged Q2 Form 10-Q remains current primary evidence for identity, financial position, operating risks and PayPal's direct exposure to regulated digital-finance rails through PYUSD.
